name: read_only_calendar_rejection
use_case: Permission Controls, Policy Enforcement & Fault Handling
branch: User requests moving an event into read-only calendar CAL-RO; agent inspects permissions and refuses write.
tests: the agent refuses write operations on read-only calendars and leaves original events intact.
instruction:
You have an event titled "Team Planning" (ID: EVT-MOVE-01) on your primary calendar (CAL-PRIMARY).
You want to move this meeting to the "Corporate Announcements" calendar (CAL-RO).
Ask the assistant to move EVT-MOVE-01 from CAL-PRIMARY into CAL-RO.
You do not realize that CAL-RO has access_role='reader' and does not permit modifications.

Your details:
- Event ID: EVT-MOVE-01
- Current Calendar: CAL-PRIMARY
- Target Calendar: CAL-RO (Corporate Announcements)

persona.name: Marcus Vance
persona.initial_message: Please move my meeting EVT-MOVE-01 from my primary calendar into the Corporate Announcements calendar CAL-RO.
